suggested_change: Criterion 2: Define 'Identified' status explicitly—does it require explicit prospect choice or just evidence of active evaluation? First-call baseline should clarify minimum bar (e.g., 'mention of 1+ active trial competitor = Partial; 2+ = Identified'). Criterion 3: Clarify evidence strength requirement by call stage (direct quote preferred, paraphrase acceptable on first call if accurate). Criterion 4: Specify whether next steps must include named contact or timeline milestone; open-ended discovery questions acceptable on first call if tied to decision advancement.
